description: Read workspaces, projects, versions and trained models, create projects, upload images, and run model inference on the serverless host with Roboflow.

api.description: Check that the key works; the route answers 200 either way, so `authenticated` reports whether a workspace actually came back

fields.description: The workspace slug the key belongs to. Absent when the request was not authenticated.
True when a workspace came back, which is the only proof the key works.

api.description: Upload one image to a project by URL or base64; a duplicate is reported as such rather than as a failure

fields.description: The project URL slug, or a workspace/project ID whose workspace is the API key's own.
A publicly reachable image URL, or a base64 data URI. Up to 20MB.
The file name to record, when the image is a data URI.
A batch name to group the upload under.
Tags for the new image.
The image ID, for a later annotation.

api.description: Run a trained model on an image on the serverless inference host, returning predictions and their count; billed per image

fields.description: The model ID from models.list `url`, in the form project/version, or workspace/model for a model not tied to a version.
A publicly reachable image URL, a base64 string, or a data URI. Base64 is sent as `image_type=base64`.
url sends `image` in the query; base64 sends the raw image in the request body. HTTP URLs select url when imageType is omitted; other strings select base64.
The confidence threshold, 0 to 1, to filter predictions.
The IoU threshold above which two boxes are treated as duplicates.
The most predictions to return.
The input image, with its width and height.

fields.type: { x?: number | null, y?: number | null, width?: number | null, height?: number | null, confidence?: number | null, class?: string | null, class_id?: number | null, detection_id?: string | null }[] | Record<string, JsonValue> | null
fields.description: Detection and single-label classification return arrays. Multi-label classification returns a class-keyed object; semantic segmentation returns a mask object.
How many predictions came back.
Inference time in seconds.

api.description: List a project's trained models with their task, architecture and metrics; each `url` is the model ID `infer` takes

fields.description: A Neural Architecture Search run ID. Returns only that run's models, or an empty array.

output.type: { url?: string | null, version?: string | null, train?: { status?: string | null } | null, taskType?: string | null, modelType?: string | null, name?: string | null, created?: string | null, metrics?: { map50?: number | null, map5095?: number | null, precision?: number | null, recall?: number | null, f1?: number | null, accuracy?: number | null } | null }[]

api.description: Create a project of a given type in an annotation group, optionally licensed onto Universe

fields.description: Letters, numbers, dashes, underscores and spaces only.

fields.type: object-detection | single-label-classification | multi-label-classification | instance-segmentation | semantic-segmentation | keypoint-detection | action-recognition | anomaly-detection
fields.description: anomaly-detection needs the feature turned on and its own annotation group.
The annotation group: a noun for what you label, such as sharks. Projects in one group share classes.

fields.type: Private | Public Domain | MIT | CC BY 4.0 | BY-NC-SA 4.0 | ODbL v1.0
fields.description: Private keeps the project private; any other value publishes it on Universe. Required on a public plan, which cannot create a private project.
A project folder ID to create it in.
The new project ID.
